description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Indianapolis market after PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-FOUNDER-PROMOTION-004: the 257-identity promotion census and the 48-record founder-signed authority (24 pet-friendly, 24 verified no-pets) of PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-FOUNDER-REVIEW-002 / -PROMOTION-AUTHORITY-PREP-003. It describes only this market's reviewed authority and grants no deployment authorization.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is structurally consistent and safe to publish as a static bundle. It is not a deployment authorization and it makes no claim that the market is complete -- 209 of its 257 confirmed identities remain unresolved (26 BUDGET_DEFERRED, 17 ALTERNATE_LANE_REQUIRED, 149 without an official URL, and the rest brand-excluded or settled without a publishable policy).

identity_census.note: The committed census is the promoted Indianapolis identity universe (PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-HARDENED-RECENSUS-002 265 -> PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-PROMOTION-AUTHORITY-PREP-003 shadow 257, promoted by PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-FOUNDER-PROMOTION-004). Policy publication is restricted to the founder-signed authority.

reconciliation.note: Counts are derived from the promoted census, the policy package and the exclusion shard; unresolved is not negative pet evidence.

policy_package.note: The Indianapolis policy package is the sole identity authority for its 24 verified pet-friendly profiles, projected from indianapolis_in_proposed_authority_003.json with founder decisions 1 and 3 applied and published by PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-FOUNDER-PROMOTION-004; no hard-coded allow-list is repeated here.
policy_package.schema_note: Schema 1.3; each record carries its founder decision binding, its withholdings with their sentences and its evidence references.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: The five founder HOLDs of PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-FOUNDER-REVIEW-002 were resolved in PREP-003; every unresolved census identity (deferred, alternate-lane, no official URL, brand-excluded, identity-mismatched or policy-not-found) has no seed row and no public route.

routes.note: Routes are derived from the 24 published records and the committed Indianapolis corridor assignment; unresolved identities are absent.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
